description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for interpreting 'talk directives' in a software project, including a struct for directive parameters, a parse result, and a parser utility with methods for extracting directive data from textual input.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: A struct representing parameters for a talking directive, including voice settings, speech rate, and other speech synthesis options.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the result of parsing a talk directive, including the parsed directive if available, the remaining stripped text, and any unknown keys encountered.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to parse text strings into TalkDirective objects, handling JSON extraction, key parsing, and error cases.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse a string input into a TalkDirectiveParseResult, extracting JSON directive data from the text.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract a string value from JSON data for given keys.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract a Double value from JSON data for given keys.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract an Int value from JSON data for given keys.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Helper method to extract a Bool value from JSON data for given keys.
